To move BeamCtrl to another phone, back up here, copy the file to the new phone, then tap Restore from a file in BeamCtrl there. The file holds every remote and setting, but never the app lock PIN or fingerprint: set the app lock up again on the new phone. The file isn't encrypted, so keep it somewhere private. BeamCtrl isn't in Android's cloud backup or phone-to-phone transfer, so this file is the only copy of your remotes off this phone.
